# Murmur Voice Dictation: lbwalton.github.io/murmur

> Murmur is push-to-talk dictation for iPhone, Windows, and macOS made by
> Eze Media LLC. On iPhone it is a dictation-first keyboard: tap the mic
> key, speak, and cleaned-up text appears at the cursor in any app. Users
> supply their own transcription API key (Groq's free tier by default; any
> OpenAI-compatible endpoint works). The developer runs no servers and
> collects no data at all.

## What Murmur is

- A custom iOS keyboard plus companion app. Apple forbids microphone use
  inside keyboards, so the first dictation of a session opens the app
  (recording starts instantly), and later dictations record in place while
  the app holds a warm microphone in the background with the orange
  indicator visible.
- The keyboard extension contains no networking and no audio code.
- Speech cleanup is configurable: exact words, light punctuation, or full
  structure. Spoken commands like "new line" work. Failed cleanup falls
  back to the raw transcript, so words are never lost.
- Personal dictionary, learned corrections, and text expansions are stored
  on the device. Expansion values never appear in network requests.
- Also available as a push-to-talk tray app for Windows and macOS.

## Pricing

- Free. Users pay only their own API provider, and Groq's free tier is
  sufficient for typical use.

## Pages

- https://lbwalton.github.io/murmur/ : what Murmur is and how it protects privacy
- https://lbwalton.github.io/murmur/support/ : two-minute setup and frequently asked questions
- https://lbwalton.github.io/murmur/privacy/ : full privacy policy (summary: nothing is collected)
